The durable VTID-05082 contract is what is now asserted: index.html wires BOTH modules, and the served svg-preview.js carries the sanitizer and the window.SvgPreview global the console depends on. express.static (gateway src/index.ts) serves svg-preview.js regardless of query string, so the unversioned path returns the same file. Nothing is deleted or loosened: the renderer check is strengthened (SvgPreview added), serving and wiring are still proven.
